# Assemble notched arc

Reduced from CAD-Recode validation stem `226`. The outer region is a
circular segment with centre (27.5, 17.5), radius √72.5 and chord x=28. The
notch removes a trapezoid of height 15 with widths 2 and 3. The sloped edge
of the notch stays inside the disc because both endpoints are strictly
inside it and the disc is convex. The prism is 5 deep.

`oracle.json` records this program on CadQuery 2.3.0 and Open CASCADE
7.9.3.0.

Adapted from CAD-Recode validation by Danila Rukhovich, Elona Dupont,
Dimitrios Mallis, Kseniya Cherenkova, Anis Kacem and Djamila Aouada.
